normalization_notes: AirTrunk total-capacity values with a plus sign are lower-bound observations at named location/campus scope; they are not IT, grid or facility MW columns
AirTrunk design PUE is stored as a design observation with null measurement period; values displayed as less-than preserve the qualifier
Vertiv voltage ranges remain observations; no nominal voltage or kW is inferred from voltage and current
Accelerator maximum power/TDP is never treated as server or rack input power
Africa Data Centres values labelled client or critical IT load are normalized only at their stated design/ultimate basis; generic power/site-capacity MW remain observations
NBO1 37.5 MW is grid capacity because the facility sheet explicitly calls it campus capacity secured from utility
Vertiv kVA and Eaton kW/kVA remain separate; no active power is inferred from apparent power, voltage or current
Eaton internal-battery runtimes preserve their stated loads and approximate-runtime caveat
Teraco critical IT MW, utility MW and apparent-power MVA remain separate; current and ultimate bases are explicit
Schneider Galaxy VS kW and kVA are both source-reported at unity power factor; battery amp-hour labels are not converted to nominal or usable energy
KL1 AI-ready language is not treated as evidence of deployed accelerators
ODATA campus aggregates remain excluded from all capacity sums; QR01/QR03 ultimate and operating IT observations are not counted as facilities
QR03 200/400 MW electrical infrastructure observations are not normalized as IT, grid or facility MW
STULZ normalized cooling capacity is net sensible cooling at the exact rating point; total sensible cooling and electrical component powers remain observations
STULZ modulating free-cooling water temperature and medium-volume-flow values retain the OEM's printed units; grouped size/dimension rows remain unset where an individual model mapping is ambiguous
STULZ R134a availability follows the OEM's printed airflow N/A mask; only 13 ASR and 10 ALR populated configurations are accepted
Antel's greater-than 1,000 final rack statement remains a lower-bound observation rather than an exact rack_count
Tigo's total site, corporate allocation, initial and ultimate rack/area boundaries remain separate observations rather than one normalized count
Meta fleet cards are campus aggregates with unknown lifecycle; break-ground years remain year-precision observations and investments retain currency and lower-bound qualifiers
PowerUPS 6000 kVA is normalized only for the 19 explicitly printed topology/rating rows; active kW, grouped dimensions and family efficiency are not assigned
Trinergy CE active output is normalized from the exact OEM table at 40 C; up-to efficiency claims remain qualified observations because load conditions are undisclosed
Carrier 19DV cooling and electrical ratings retain AHRI water temperatures, fouling factors, pass count and water-side pressure; 50 Hz and 60 Hz model suffixes remain separate exact configurations
Raxio IT MW is design maximum only; connection kV and cooling provision MW remain observations and are not normalized as grid or facility demand
Raxio year/month lifecycle markers remain verbatim observations rather than fabricated full dates; only MZ1 has an exact commissioning date from a dated opening release
Raxio PUE 1.3 observations use unspecified kind with null measurement period and source boundary because the operator does not label them measured, design or target values
Cummins kW and kVA are normalized only from each exact Data Center Continuous row and remain separate; prime, standby and general continuous values remain observations
Generator equipment ratings are never treated as facility backup-generator capacity; no power factor is inferred from reported kW and kVA
